mainEntity.name: How do I find an accountant near me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your postcode and needs in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted accountant whose services fit your situation — not just any firm on a map. The matching is free with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: Are the accountants near me actually local?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Matching prioritises firms in your area. Many also offer phone and video consultations, but the matched firm is local to your area and understands your state's tax rules.

mainEntity.name: Can a local accountant deal with the ATO for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — a registered tax agent can receive your ATO correspondence, respond to queries, negotiate payment plans and lodge objections on your behalf. Tell us if you need ATO representation and we will match accordingly.

mainEntity.name: Is 'accountant near me' matching really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free for individuals and businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm.

mainEntity.name: What services can a local accountant help me with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our network covers the full range — individual and business tax returns, BAS and GST, bookkeeping, SMSF setup and compliance, CGT advice, payroll and STP2, cloud accounting setup, and ATO dispute support. Tell us what you need in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that offers those specific services.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get matched with a local accountant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: What if I prefer phone or video consultations rather than visiting an office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many firms in our network offer fully digital cloud services via Xero, MYOB, and phone or video consultations. You can specify whether you prefer in-person meetings or online service during your questionnaire — whichever suits your schedule.

mainEntity.name: Can I change accountants if I'm not happy with the match?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm. If the first match isn't the right fit, let us know and we will connect you with another vetted local accountant whose services better align with your needs. The matching service is always free.
